dataFeedLimitationsAndRules.volumeAvailability: Bar volume received in tick stream; tick count and L2 orderbook depth absent.
dataFeedLimitationsAndRules.timeframePrecision: 1-minute and 5-minute candle timestamps anchored to candle start time (ms Unix epoch).
dataFeedLimitationsAndRules.activeTabRequirement: TradeSea browser tab must remain active/focused to prevent Chrome background WebSocket throttling.
dataFeedLimitationsAndRules.historicalInitialWindowSeparation: Initial chart historical backfill candles flagged as IS_HISTORICAL_INITIAL; only prospective live closed candles (IS_PROSPECTIVE_LIVE=true) ingested into evaluation ledger.

disruptionAndIncompleteSessions.sessionRejectionCriteria: Any session with cumulative unrecoverable data gap exceeding 15 minutes OR >30% missing candles is marked INVALID_INCOMPLETE.
disruptionAndIncompleteSessions.reconnectDeduplication: Enforced via composite primary key [symbol, timeframe, timestamp]. Duplicate frames discarded without ledger corruption.

correctedDecember2026RolloverAudit.contractRolloverVerdict: ALL 40 preregistered sessions in s10_session_manifest.json (2026-10-12 to 2026-12-07) terminate PRIOR to the December contract rollover date under BOTH 8-day and Thursday rules. 100% of sessions strictly use contract NQZ6 / MNQZ6 with 0 rollover discontinuity.
